Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the birth year was 1963 based on a misinterpretation of the Wikipedia page's age field ("age 62"). The Planner reasoned that "Using the live-updated age and current year (2025), the preliminary birth year computes to 1963," failing to realize that the age displayed on the Wikipedia page (62) was likely calculated based on the year the page was last updated (2023 or 2024), not the current year 2025, or simply miscounting (2025 - 62 = 1963, but if the age is 62 in 2024, birth is 1962). The Planner explicitly overruled the clear text evidence "Born December 10, 1962" in favor of this erroneous calculation, leading to the wrong final answer of 1963 instead of the correct 1962 supported by multiple sources.
